sentences.text:
Shri Rajesh Joshi G.A appearing on behalf of Advocate   ORDER This Criminal Appeal under Section 374(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 24.09.2013 in Session Case No.65/2013 by the Additional Session Judge Mandleshwar, District - Khargone, whereby appellant/accused - Mehtab has been convicted under Section 366/34, 376(2)(g) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 7 years R.I, 10 years R.I and fine of Rs.500/-,Rs.500/- respectively with default stipulation.
2.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge Mandleshwar, District - Khargone
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This appeal arises out of the incident dated 01-02/02/2013 in which accused abducted the prosecutrix and committed rape with her in that regard Crime No.19/2013 was registered at Police Station Balkawda, Khargone.
3. The PUD No.829/Warrant/2025 dated 20.05.2025 of Jail Superintendent, District Jail, Khargone mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 13.10.2020 after completing the sentence.

Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
